evidence.title: ObsidianUI - React & Tailwind CSS Components Library

name: ObsidianUI
summary: Open-source React component library of animated components, blocks and landing page templates built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.
description: Copy-paste React component library by Atharv: animated and interactive components (draggable marquee, art gallery, hover image, flip text, scroll effects, cursor effects, canvas and WebGL backgrounds), blocks such as Dashboard Shell, Analytics Dashboard and Status Bars, and landing page templates like Project One. 103 registry items install with npx shadcn@latest add from the public registry, or copy the source manually. Agents get llms.txt and Markdown docs, a read-only HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, and a local stdio MCP server. MIT licensed.
contains: 103 registry items, including supporting UI primitives
components: marquee, art gallery, hover image, flip text, scroll, cursor, loader, OTP input
blocks: Dashboard Shell, Analytics Dashboard, Status Bars, Split Showcase, v-prism
installs with npx shadcn@latest add from /r/{name}.json; registry at /r/registry.json
read-only HTTP API with OpenAPI spec plus Markdown versions of every page
local stdio MCP server (npm run mcp) and agent instructions for coding agents
MIT licensed; built by Atharv (@athrix_codes), Vercel hosting sponsor
